small_two_page.description: Northwind Collective — IT Equipment & Device Security Policy, 2 pages

qa.question: How many business days does a standard equipment request take to ship?
What is the minimum length required for a device password?
Within how many hours must a lost or stolen device be reported to IT Security?
Can personal devices be used to access the customer database over VPN?
qa.expected_answer: No — personal devices may never access the customer database, regardless of VPN status.
qa.evidence: or the customer database, regardless of VPN status

qa.question: Who must approve new software installation on a company laptop?
qa.expected_answer: The employee's manager and a security review by IT, unless the software is on the pre-approved list.

qa.question: How many business days do employees have to return equipment after their last day?
qa.evidence: within five business days of an employee's last day

qa.question: How long is the hardware replacement warranty on company laptops?
Who is the IT Operations Lead responsible for this policy?

long_fifty_pages.description: Northwind Collective — Employee Handbook, 61 pages, 15 chapters

qa.question: Who is the Chief Executive Officer of Northwind Collective?
Where is Northwind Collective's headquarters located?
How many vacation days do employees accrue per month of service?
qa.expected_answer: Two paid vacation days per month, up to a maximum of twenty-four days per year.
qa.evidence: two paid vacation days per month of service

qa.question: How many weeks of paid parental leave does a primary caregiver receive?
What percentage of the health insurance premium does the company contribute for the employee?
How often does each office location run a fire drill?
qa.note: Fact is in Chapter 15, near the end of the document — tests long-document retrieval, not just early-page recall.
qa.evidence: fire drill at least twice per year

qa.question: Within how many hours must a lost or stolen device be reported to IT Security?
qa.note: Fact is in Chapter 9 (middle of the document).

qa.question: What is the referral bonus for a successful technical hire?
qa.evidence: two thousand dollars for a successful technical hire

qa.question: How many hours of continuous flight time now trigger the business-class travel threshold?
qa.expected_answer: Ten hours (raised from eight in the most recent policy review).
qa.evidence: from eight hours to ten hours of flight time

qa.question: Who conducts exit interviews?
qa.expected_answer: HR conducts exit interviews — never the departing employee's direct manager.
qa.note: Fact is in Chapter 14, near the end of the document — tests long-document retrieval.
qa.evidence: Exit interviews are conducted by HR

sample_docx.description: Northwind Collective — Expense Reimbursement Policy, DOCX

qa.question: Within how many days must expense reports be submitted?
qa.expected_answer: Twenty-one days of the purchase date.
qa.evidence: within twenty-one days of the purchase date

qa.question: What is the receipt requirement threshold for a single expense?
qa.expected_answer: A receipt is required for any single expense over fifteen dollars; meal expenses always require a receipt regardless of amount.
qa.evidence: any single expense over fifteen dollars

qa.question: Who approves expense reports under two hundred dollars?
qa.evidence: approved by the employee's direct manager alone

qa.question: How many business days does reimbursement take after approval?
qa.expected_answer: Seven business days, or up to fourteen business days if flagged for additional review.

qa.question: Is alcohol reimbursable under this policy, even during approved business travel?
qa.expected_answer: No, alcohol is never reimbursable, even during approved business travel.

qa.question: What happens on a second instance of personal corporate card use within twelve months?
qa.evidence: results in the corporate card being revoked

qa.question: Who is the Finance Operations Manager and policy owner?

non_english.description: Northwind Collective — Politique de Congés Payés (French), 1-2 pages

qa.question: Combien de jours de congés les employés accumulent-ils par mois de service ?
qa.expected_answer: Deux jours par mois, jusqu'à vingt-quatre jours par an.
qa.evidence: deux jours de congés payés par mois de service

qa.question: Combien de jours de congés non utilisés peuvent être reportés à l'année suivante ?
qa.evidence: jusqu'à un maximum de dix jours

qa.question: Combien de semaines de congé payé le parent principal reçoit-il ?
Combien de jours de congé maladie payé les employés reçoivent-ils par an ?
qa.expected_answer: Dix jours, non cumulables d'une année à l'autre.
qa.evidence: dix jours de congé maladie payé par an

qa.question: Qui est la responsable des Ressources Humaines ?
Combien de temps à l'avance une demande de congé de plus de trois jours doit-elle être soumise ?
qa.expected_answer: Au moins deux semaines à l'avance.
qa.evidence: au moins deux semaines à l'avance
